siteTagline.zh: 私人向导 · 乌兹别克斯坦

heroTitle.en: Four cities, one road, in the right order
heroTitle.zh: 四座城，一条路，按正确的顺序走

heroSubtitle.en: I am Wu Minjun, a private guide based in Samarkand. Tell me which cities you want and I will put them in the order the Silk Road already put them — then drive it with you.
heroSubtitle.zh: 我是吴敏俊，常驻撒马尔罕的私人向导。告诉我你想去哪几座城市，我会把它们排成丝绸之路本来的顺序——然后一路陪你走完。

companyDescription.en: Wu Minjun is an independent private guide based in Samarkand, working with small groups and families across Uzbekistan in Chinese and English. Not an agency — one guide, one car, your itinerary.
companyDescription.zh: 吴敏俊是常驻撒马尔罕的独立私人向导，以中文和英文接待小型团队与家庭客人，服务范围覆盖乌兹别克斯坦全境。这里没有旅行社——一位向导、一辆车、你自己的行程。

aboutBlurb.en: Every place on this site is somewhere I take people myself, which is why there are fifteen of them and not two hundred. Message me on WeChat and we can plan the route before you book anything.
aboutBlurb.zh: 这个网站上的每一处，都是我亲自带客人去过的地方——所以只有十五处，而不是两百处。先加我微信，我们可以在你订任何东西之前把路线定下来。
